sample_purpose: Illustrative source-balanced subset of operational subcooled pilot sample; not statistically representative of all records, fluids, branches, or QC states
selection: Sort source_file lexicographically, within each group sort ascending by pandas hash_pandas_object over all columns converted to string; round-robin take up to 120 rows, at most one per group per pass. Drop incomplete α/Nu pairs if any. No physical values recomputed.
note: The initial source sample has undergone modelling-oriented filtering; it cannot demonstrate rejected QC or ambiguous branch records.
